operators.name: custom_max_view_as_complex
semantics: Computes max over dim=1 with keepdim=True, producing float32 max_values with shape [batch_size,1,height,width,2] and int64 indices same shape.
Then converts max_values after squeezing dim=1 to complex64 via view_as_complex (last dimension size 2 interpreted as real and imaginary parts).
Returns a tuple of (complex_values, indices) where indices retain the keepdim shape and max_values are converted to complex.
Indices correspond to the argmax along dim=1 for each real/imag component independently, preserving torch.max semantics.
The complex output shape is [batch_size, height, width] and dtype torch.complex64.
Performs max reduction along dimension 1 (channels) with keepdim=True.
Input shape [128,2,512,512,2], output max_values float32 shape [128,1,512,512,2], indices int64 same shape.
The last dimension (size 2) is treated independently for real and imaginary parts during max reduction.
Converts the last dimension of size 2 to complex64 via view_as_complex.
